evidence_limits: This is the bounded 155-control clock-component focus projection, not a complete original source/test or executable archive collection.
Compressed test and CLI executable bodies were not opened or rehashed; their hashes remain worker metadata claims only.
A named test PASS records only an exact test process transcript with exit 0 and the expected one-test summary.
CLI and sweep observations do not establish chemistry calibration, product acceptance, or fleet-wide compatibility.
A STOPPED worker is a partial result; controls without captured records are reported NOT_REACHED, never passed.
